mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, conditions are clear near Badger Ridge Middle School, with the third quarter moon visible overhead.

The City of Verona provides ongoing engineering reports to the City Council, which are available to the public online. Additionally, those interested in community service can look into becoming a tri-shaw pilot at the Senior Center to help seniors enjoy the outdoors, or apply for seasonal recreation department jobs.

There is plenty going on in town. Today, you can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy live music at Concerts in the Park, or test your knowledge at Hop Haus Trivia. Looking ahead, we have live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee tomorrow, followed by the Dane County Farmers' Market and music at Paddy Mac's this Friday.
In our weekly police report, on July 31st, officers conducted a stop that resulted in the arrest of a driver for an O W I and citations for a suspended vehicle registration.
Today's featured flavor is the Chocolate Caramel Twist. If you are craving a treat, Culver's is currently closed but will open at 10 AM today.
